derivation: dative case feminine of a derivative of G4228 (πούς) (as adverb);

occurrences.text: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
